Triage: **`pm:queue`** — concrete defect, enumerated key list, mechanical fix plus a proposed pairing assertion; German users see the wrong closing quote today.

- **Anchor (read, not inferred)**: verified on `origin/main` @ `b750823` (de.ts untouched by the just-merged PR #3874) — full-file scan of `packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts` counts 44× U+201E („) against 24× U+201C (“), with 22 mismatched `„…"` pairs by regex. The card's own census (41:21, 20 keys) was taken slightly earlier / by-key — same class, marginally different numbers; the claimant should recount at landing rather than trusting either figure (main moves ~daily on this file family).
- **Gate blindness confirmed by the card**: parity/key/drift gates never read values — same value-domain blind spot family as #3844/#3875/#3810.
- **Scope note**: fix = flip the closing quote on the mismatched values; the proposed invariant (count(„) == count(“) in de.ts) is the durable half — without it the next backfill re-introduces the drift. Other packs measured clean by the card (fr/zh/ja) — do not expand scope without measuring.
- **Coordination**: #3546 slice 7 (in flight, no PR yet) touches de.ts additively and deliberately wrote its new key correctly paired — claimant should re-read the file at claim time.
- **Dedupe**: no open card or PR names these keys or the quote-pairing invariant; #3866 is the adjacent "census method itself wrong" precedent, distinct face.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

- 分支:`claude/issue-3876-de-quote-pairs`
- 修法:20 个值的收尾引号改为德语闭引号 `“`(以卡片清单为准、逐值复核邻域;en 一字不动,drift 门应报 0 changed);钉子按精确值断言 + 「新的 „…" 错配不得再入」的扫描钉(正则注意 `\p{L}`+`u`,#3866 教训)。
- 文件面:`packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts` + 独立钉子文件(名带 3876);⛔ 不碰 3546 家族测试。
- 与在飞 #3819、#3872、#3896 零相交。
